item: Import time is no longer stored as a publication date (PDF import, statistics corpus, Wikipedia fallback); boot clean-up of the old values
summary: The PDF importer and the statistics corpus wrote now() into articles.published_at and the Wikipedia corpus fell back to now() or the page's last check time, so a 2009 report read 'Published' on its import day and anchored year-less dates to it. They now store NULL (Wikipedia keeps a recorded revision time); created_at keeps the import time. clear_import_time_publication_dates runs in init_db every boot (an older backup merged later brings the values back): only the pdf.import.local source and statistics.<agency>.local sources with source_type statistics, and every value there (the writers only ever stored now(); a merge adopting one from a hash twin copies another machine's import time, so a 1 h proximity test was dropped after the second review showed it missed exactly that case); read-only (one indexed SELECT LIMIT 1) when nothing is left. Stored Wikipedia rows are not cleaned (a check-time fallback cannot be told from a real revision): OPEN_QUEUE R727 entry.
